description: This is a unit test class for the PublisherService in a Java-based book management application. It uses JUnit 5 and Mockito to test various methods of the PublisherService, ensuring correct behavior when handling publisher data.

classes.name: PublisherServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PublisherService, verifying methods such as findById, save, findAll, delete, deleteAll, and count.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and the PublisherService instance before each test.

methods.name: findById_throwsNullPointerException_ifIdIsNull
methods.description: Tests that findById throws NullPointerException when passed null.

methods.name: canFindByNonNullId
methods.description: Verifies that findById calls the repository with a valid ID.

methods.name: save_throwsNullPointerException_ifPublisherIsNull
methods.description: Tests that save throws NullPointerException when passed null.

methods.name: canSaveValidPublisher
methods.description: Ensures that save calls the repository's save method with a valid Publisher instance.

methods.name: canFindAll
methods.description: Verifies that findAll invokes the repository's findAll method.

methods.name: delete_throwsNullPointerException_ifPublisherIsNull
methods.description: Tests that delete throws NullPointerException when passed null.

methods.name: canDeleteValidPublisher
methods.description: Ensures that delete calls the repository's delete method with a valid Publisher.

methods.name: canDeleteAll
methods.description: Verifies that deleteAll calls the repository's deleteAll method.

methods.name: canCount
methods.description: Verifies that count calls the repository's count method.
